participant_1.name: Lila
participant_1.personality: Lila is creative and introspective, often reflecting on her passions while enjoying simple pleasures like dancing and reading.
participant_1.background: I compete in dog agility classes. I went to school for chemistry but work in a bookstore. I do not care about fashion. I hate the color orange. I dance on the weekends.

participant_2.name: Amina
participant_2.personality: Amina is resilient and spirited, with a love for vibrant colors and engaging conversations, despite her challenging past.
participant_2.background: I was born in Somalia. Now I live in the United States. I was forced to marry when I was a teenager. My aunt helped me escape when I was 18.
